oe_ti_grant_roman_law = { # 授予罗马法统
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    allow = { scope:actor = { oe_ti_law_can_request = yes } }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        target_flag = target_country
        name = "oe_ti_grant_roman_law_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_ti_grant_roman_law_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { oe_ti_law_eligible = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } scope:actor = { oe_ti_law_can_request = yes } exists = scope:target_country scope:target_country = { oe_ti_law_eligible = yes } }
            custom_tooltip = oe_ti_grant_roman_law_tt
            hidden_effect = { scope:target_country = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_law_theme } scope:actor = { oe_ti_law_request = yes } }
        }
    }
}

    type = internationalorganization

    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        target_flag = target_country
        name = "oe_ti_grant_despotate_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_ti_grant_despotate_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { oe_ti_despotate_target = yes }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        source = actor
        interaction_source_list = { scope:actor = { every_character = { limit = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes } add_to_list = source } } }
        target_flag = target_character
        name = "oe_ti_grant_despotate_select_char"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_ti_grant_despotate_none_char"
        column = { data = character_info }
        visible = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes is_eligible_heir_baseline = scope:target_country }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                scope:actor = { oe_ti_can_grant_despotate = yes }
                exists = scope:target_country exists = scope:target_character
                scope:target_country = { oe_ti_despotate_target = yes }
                scope:target_character = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_ti_grant_despotate_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:target_country = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_theme }
                scope:target_character = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_char }
                scope:actor = { oe_ti_grant_despotate_do = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
